definitions.explanation: The fatty belly meat of tuna, prized for sushi and sashimi because it melts in the mouth. Graded by fat content into the fattiest cut, 大トロ, and the medium cut, 中トロ.

examples.japanese: トロ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧だ。
お⟦{寿司屋|すしや}→寿司屋：10166_sushiya⟧さん⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{大|おお}トロ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{頼|たの}んだ→頼む：01104_tanomu⟧。
examples.english: I ordered the fattiest tuna at the sushi restaurant.

examples.japanese: {中|ちゅう}トロ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{赤身|あかみ}→赤身：19617_akami⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧トロ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{間|あいだ}→間：00914_aida⟧くらい⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{脂|あぶら}→脂：01916_abura⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧のり⟦{具合|ぐあい}→具合：01391_guai⟧で、⟦{一番|いちばん}→一番：01140_ichiban⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Medium-fatty tuna, with fat somewhere between lean red meat and toro, is the most popular.

notes:
Named for its texture: とろり⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{溶|と}ける→溶ける：02302_tokeru⟧, melting smoothly. Also used of other fatty fish cuts and of pork: ⟦サーモン→サーモン：08836_saamon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧トロ, {豚|とん}トロ.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {大|おお}トロ: the fattiest tuna belly
- {中|ちゅう}トロ: medium-fatty tuna
- ネギトロ: minced fatty tuna with green onion
- トロ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{口|くち}→口：00560_kuchi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{溶|と}ける→溶ける：02302_tokeru⟧: toro melts in the mouth

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{赤身|あかみ}→赤身：19617_akami⟧: lean red tuna meat — the less fatty, cheaper cut
